tasks.instruction_text: Show me **Men's Blazers** in **Black**, **Size M** — apply the Category (Blazer), Color (Black), and Size (M) chips. Verify all three appear in the header chip rail before listing items.
Apply **Blazer** + **Black** + **Size M** + **Uniqlo** (line). After all four chips sit in the header bar, × off the Uniqlo chip so you see Blazers from any line in Black/M.
Apply **Blazer** + **Black** + **Size M** + **Size L**. Then realize you only want M — × off the Size L chip so the chip rail shows Blazer + Black + Size M.
Cross-shop colors: apply **Blazer** + **Black** + **Navy** + **Size M**. Then × off the Black chip so the integrated header chip rail is left with Blazer + Navy + Size M.
No filters — how many items total in the UNILO catalog?
Without filtering, which item has the highest customer rating, plus the rating value?
No filters — how many items are priced under $50 versus $50-and-up?
Apply the **Blazer** (category) chip AND the **Black** (color) chip. After both pills sit in the header bar, tell me how many black blazers are listed.

Multi-step Fara replay: apply **Blazer** + **Black** + **Size M** + the $80–$199 price band. Then × off the price chip so price is unconstrained. Tell me how many black blazers (size M) remain across all prices.
Apply **Blazer** + **Black** + **Size M**. Once those three chips are pinned in the header chip rail, name the highest-rated black men's blazer in size M (title + rating).
